chapter_regressions.judgment: Read243–276 continuously. Seven headings repair the opening bank navigation (D005), and the final reference correctly names earlier11.2.1 (D006). Classification, credit history, dated discounting, signed POCI allowance, transfer rights and actual settlement retain their separate conditions. Capital or final-cash agreement is never used to infer payment success or a correct interest basis. Wider bank joins and predictive/operative-rule validation remain open.
